//: `test/**/*.tsx` was missing until WP6-7, so every conformance suite in this app — seven of them —
ran under vitest (which strips types without checking them) and was invisible to `pnpm typecheck`.
A mis-shaped `StatefulHarness` or a wrong `RenderedTree` field could not fail CI. `apps/mobile`'s
tsconfig has always included both extensions, so the two renderers' suites were held to different
standards — in the direction that matters least, since `apps/web` is what survives WP6-8.
